name: security-audit
description: A full, source-first security audit: map trust boundaries, hunt by attack class against a coverage plan, let an independent reviewer try to refute every finding, and get a report with confirmed findings, open leads with exact blockers, smallest fixes and an honest coverage statement.

variables.name: profile
variables.about: quick, standard or deep: how broad and redundant the run is; the evidence bar never changes.

variables.name: output-dir
variables.about: Where the audit files go; outside the repository unless a git-ignored folder is chosen.
